usage: <PROG> [-h] [--mode {fix,agent}]
                                 [--data_dir DATA_DIR]
                                 [--dataset_profile_json DATASET_PROFILE_JSON]
                                 [--raw_data_dir RAW_DATA_DIR]

                                 [--exp_id EXP_ID] [--run_name RUN_NAME]
                                 [--file_index FILE_INDEX] [-c] [-p]
                                 [-n NUM_WORKERS] [-w]
                                 [--output_json OUTPUT_JSON]
                                 [--task_manifest TASK_MANIFEST]
                                 [--task_data_path_id TASK_DATA_PATH_ID]
                                 [--task_data_path_identity TASK_DATA_PATH_IDENTITY]

Single-file denoising score (Option B, global s_max).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mode {fix,agent}    Baseline (fix) or agent-produced (agent) denoised
                        file.
  --data_dir DATA_DIR, -d DATA_DIR
                        Directory containing the denoised HDF5 file.
  --dataset_profile_json DATASET_PROFILE_JSON
                        Path to a resolved Dataset Profile JSON. OMITTED
                        resolves the Regime-A TIDMAD adapter; SUPPLIED but
                        broken fails closed.
  --raw_data_dir RAW_DATA_DIR
                        Directory containing the raw abra_validation_XXXX.h5
                        files (used for CH2 center-freq pickup). Default:
                        TIDMAD_DATA_DIR.
  --anchor_map ANCHOR_MAP
                        Path to segment_anchors.json (used for global s_max).
                        Default: the committed
                        reference_data/segment_anchors.json, resolved from the
                        package location (independent of the working
                        directory).
  --denoising_model DENOISING_MODEL, -m DENOISING_MODEL
  --exp_id EXP_ID       Experiment ID (required for agent mode).
  --run_name RUN_NAME   Run name for the auto-exploration.
  --file_index FILE_INDEX, -i FILE_INDEX
                        Validation file index (0-19 fine).
  -c, --coarse          (Deprecated no-op; kept for CLI compatibility.)
  -p, --parallel        Use parallel workers inside score_vector.
  -n NUM_WORKERS, --num_workers NUM_WORKERS
  -w, --weak            (Deprecated no-op; kept for CLI compatibility.)
  --output_json OUTPUT_JSON
                        Optional path; denoising_score is merged into this
                        JSON.
  --task_manifest TASK_MANIFEST
                        Step 11 C5: the composed run's task-composition
                        manifest, emitted by the parent FROM its resolved run
                        binding only — never an operator flag. SUPPLIED -> the
                        run's DECLARED metric is composed through the same
                        authority the parent used, and a failure to compose
                        terminates this subprocess rather than falling back.
                        ABSENT -> the legacy un-composed derivation, byte-
                        identical.
  --task_data_path_id TASK_DATA_PATH_ID
                        D14-1: the child side of the task-data-path transport.
                        Emitted by the parent process FROM its resolved run
                        binding only — never an operator flag. SUPPLIED ->
                        explicit binding (an unknown id fails closed, never
                        falls back); ABSENT -> regime-A (TIDMAD
                        compatibility).
  --task_data_path_identity TASK_DATA_PATH_IDENTITY
                        Step 12 / PR-12bc C2: the PARENT-PINNED IDENTITY of
                        the implementation named by --task_data_path_id. The
                        id says WHICH implementation; this says WHICH CODE.
                        Verified BEFORE the implementation is consumed,
                        because a registry hit is never proof of identity — a
                        stale registration answers to the right name while
                        running different bytes. ABSENT -> a parent that
                        predates this transport made no claim, and a child
                        must not invent one.
